title: Morality is Non-Binary: Building a Pluralist Moral Sentence Embedding Space using Contrastive Learning
findings: The model's learned embedding space revealed a high similarity between the moral values of 'care' and 'purity'. This correlation was found to be driven by common concerns of religion and care, as exemplified by the word 'god' consistently appearing in tweets labeled with both values, particularly in the context of tweets about the Sandy hurricane.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured moral similarity between different texts. An emergent finding related to religion was the discovery of a high correlation between the moral values of 'care' and 'purity', which was partly driven by the frequent co-occurrence of the word 'god' and religious concerns in tweets about hurricane relief efforts.
